title: interior.dev
brief: Micro-interactions for React, "built for the half-second after a click". A focused little library for the small animations that make UIs feel alive.
details: interior.dev — free, open-source React micro-interaction components, "argued out to the frame": buttons, spinners, copy buttons, and the fiddly half-second-after-a-click details that make software feel expensive instead of cheap. The model is shadcn-style — one file per component, you keep the source and restyle freely (React + Tailwind + Motion, TypeScript throughout). Install via `npx shadcn@latest add https://www.interior.dev/r/copy-button.json`. The behavior is finished; the style is yours. MIT licensed. Named "Library of the Month" on 21st.dev.
